evidence.interpretation: Native COPY/version errors dominate. First fresh cohort had one protected order regression; the second had four control-vs-before and two treatment-vs-before protected regressions. Question-stage adaptation repairs every scored COPY readout in the second cohort while preserving sampled native prefix memories, so recurrent-state damage is not established as the necessary cause.

controller_keys_pilot.interpretation: Same 128 training examples, 64 steps, approximately 0.69M parameters, one initialization. Ordinary local low-rank baseline solves all pilot COPY readouts; no shared-interface advantage.

controller_keys_temporal.interpretation: Post-training token mask interventions, not retraining. Ledger-only alters both recurrent state and KV construction; no isolated GDN-write causal conclusion.

controller_keys_confirmation.interpretation: Adaptation generalizes to fresh seeds. Shared control has no demonstrated advantage over independent or ordinary local low-rank adaptation; intervals are exploratory and comparisons use one training initialization.

copy_fresh_protected_preservation.interpretation: One new rare native protected regression under one order. This is a functional symptom, not proof of recurrent-state damage; every adaptation control repairs it.

controller_timing_matched_training_pilot.interpretation: Development screen only; subsequent frozen confirmation verified the actual final checkpoint on a sample prefix. No equivalence or isolated GDN-memory claim.

controller_timing_confirmation.interpretation: High competence is achievable without altering pre-question computation on these templated tasks. Question-stage computation still includes GDN and Attention; this does not isolate compressed-memory quality or establish robust superiority.

evidence.prefix_verification_audit: Earlier timing training snapshots predate the added one-step cache check. Do not modify those historical checks. The final checkpoint was verified during frozen confirmation, and the new one-step safety path passed in a separate real-2B smoke run.

question_branch_ablation.interpretation: Post-training disablement on development cases, not retrained branch capacity. The learned question-stage solution relies mainly on GDN adapters; GDN still updates state while processing questions, and deeper native layers can mediate the answer.

initialization_replication.interpretation: Question-only success replicates for these three fixed initializations. This is not a superiority/equivalence claim, broader generalization evidence, or proof of a pure readout mechanism.

question_key_gate_components.scope: One trained initialization, eight development COPY cases and two orders. Disable learned residuals only; native downstream activations can change.
question_key_gate_components.interpretation: Key residuals dominate this checkpoint. This is not a matched-training Key-vs-gate capability comparison and does not distinguish address construction from question-time state updates.

depth_wording_generalization.interpretation: One-hop improvements do not fully generalize to deeper chains or entity-first wording. Rebuilt slices remove competing versions and recompute positions and memory.

matched_short_update_controls.interpretation: Copied target truth unchanged; shared short prefix and matched source/unrelated update lengths. Functional fragility is not localized to GDN, KV, or query formation.

original_prefix_oracle_kv.safety: All-history logits/cache/scoring/generation exact; unrestricted replay NLL error zero on one sample per checkpoint. Restricted prefix cache/logits and all 12 historical KV fields exact. Hook active on every cached scoring/decode forward.
original_prefix_oracle_kv.interpretation: Frozen ordinary adapters recover all tested answers without rebuilding prefix computation. Oracle access changes question/answer computation at all six attention layers. This does not prove GDN alone retained facts or establish a learned/efficient router.

equal_budget_kv_controls.interpretation: All necessary evidence retained; both added-record conditions have exactly equal historical token budgets on the same original prompt. Extra SET records differ in numeric contents and original positions, so this does not alone isolate semantic version interference from positional effects. Oracle identities, one initialization, eight base facts; no architecture or learned-selector claim.
equal_budget_kv_controls.audit: Three per-run audits completed; all prompt identities, original positions, preserved evidence, two extra SET counts, and exactly equal retained token counts verified.

readout_counterbalance_smoke.source_cases: first and last registered cases (short depth-one original and long depth-three entity-first)
readout_counterbalance_smoke.checks: All three masks passed exact all-history/prefix cache/logit/historical-KV checks per sampled case and checkpoint; native prefix checks for question-only checkpoints and zero-error native restoration after detaching controllers.

source_minus_unrelated.unit: base_case_id, averaging all depth/wording/orders and the three fixed initializations

fresh_counterbalanced_kv.interpretation: Oracle event selection at all six full-attention layers during question/answer processing, with original prefix intact. Both extra SETs write the same new value; source/unrelated roles swap at exact matching late token intervals. Effects describe this COPY-template family, not irreversible GDN damage, a learned router, architecture superiority, or efficient sparse kernels. Bootstrap units are base facts; initialization averages are conditional on the three fixed trained seeds. Zero empirical paired accuracy differences can yield degenerate bootstrap intervals; these do not establish equivalence or rule out effects on unseen facts. This fresh post-COPY, single-extra-record protocol also differs from the earlier two-extra-record/both-COPY-order screen; a changed result cannot be attributed only to position/value balancing.

exploratory_nll_second_difference.unit: base_case_id; exploratory answer-NLL second difference, nats per gold answer token

old_bundle_singleton_decomposition.interpretation: Exploratory decomposition on all old 60000-series cases, one frozen initialization. Singleton retained-token budgets match and their union is the previously evaluated two-extra mask. Necessary evidence and original input remain intact. Target-initial and unused-source records differ in positions and values; this identifies components of the bundled effect, not a fully isolated semantic-version cause. No recurrent-damage or architecture claim.

record_kv_smoke.checks: Short/long all-history/prefix/historical-KV identity; raw/oracle replay; question-only native prefixes and native behavior restored after detach.

record_kv_ablation.interpretation: Historical ledger-record KV is blocked only for question/answer rows in all six attention layers. Normal hybrid prefix computation, recurrent/convolution state, instruction KV and causal question/answer KV remain. This is not isolated GDN-matrix performance. Success can indicate usable information in remaining carriers; failure under a frozen perturbed readout does not establish absent information or memory damage. Dense eager masking is not an efficiency result. All queries here are post-COPY current-value queries; semantic-order and historical-version generalization remain separate requirements.

blocked_reader_generalization.interpretation: Compare recoverability under ordinary question-only or all-token local adaptation with the same blocked historical reader. Prefix carriers include recurrent and convolution states built using normal hybrid prefix attention. Neither superiority nor failure isolates GDN write quality. One fixed initialization; reused diagnostics, not untouched confirmation. Degenerate zero-effect intervals do not prove equivalence. Missing task success can reflect optimization/adapter expressivity and the intervention's distribution shift; it does not establish absent information.

blocked_reader_training_fit.interpretation: Fit of the final step-64 checkpoints on the exact 128 original training examples; no extra updates or checkpoint selection. Teacher-forced token accuracy is distinct from unrestricted greedy answer accuracy. Poor fit leaves optimizer budget and adapter expressivity unresolved and cannot prove absent memory information.

blocked_reader_budget_calibration.interpretation: One initialization, fixed repeated original training data and a reused validation split. Checkpoints and budgets were fixed before this run. No new test-cohort inference or checkpoint selection. Fitting these data does not establish semantic generalization or a new architecture; persistent failure leaves adapter/readout capacity and accessible information unresolved.

question_identity_fit_confound.interpretation: Descriptive in-sample lookup chosen with hindsight using only exact question text; not a trained or deployable baseline. A high fit rate alone could exploit question identity and would not establish prefix-memory use. This is a ceiling for this restricted deterministic lookup class, not a universal bound on history-free models that can use positions or other signals.
question_identity_fit_confound.followup: Use matched counterfactual prefixes with identical question text and token positions but distinct correct answers; report complete-family correctness as well as individual answers.

single_fact_native_counterfactual.scope: Immediate single-fact diagnostic; no absent-information or write-damage conclusion. Prefix recurrent/convolution carriers built under native hybrid attention remain.

gdn_query_capacity.interpretation: Paired same-question/position families establish partial prefix-conditioned information use through retained hybrid recurrent/convolution carriers without changing pre-question computation. No broad reliable recovery, query superiority, isolated GDN-matrix result, semantic write-damage conclusion, or shared-interface advantage.

paired_semantic_controllers.interpretation: No shared-interface advantage over independent control. semantic_single_path_controls.interpretation: Two necessary scope controls for the proposed hybrid-block co-design, not new architectures. Same augmented data, ordered identities, optimizer, seed, steps and two already-observed development orders as the four-arm reference. Parameter counts are near-matched; ranks and feature allocations differ. Changing only one parameter pathway can still affect downstream hidden states and other memory layers. Any success weakens a claim that both selected component types must be adapted; failure alone does not establish unique memory storage or semantic write damage. No fresh-confirmation or universal-superiority claim. Six models share the same 12 underlying validation event streams. Paired counts are descriptive, not six independent datasets. Good component-only answers weaken a joint-adaptation necessity claim only for the tested group, training budget and tasks; poor answers can reflect fit or capacity.

semantic_order_path_probe.interpretation: Reused-validation pathway diagnostic, not untouched confirmation. Functional rescue does not prove unique storage, ordinary write damage, or a new semantic interface. No absence-of-information claim from a failed transplant.
